newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Telecel plans to cut prices in March.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Telecel plans to cut prices in March.

text.p: Portuguese mobile phone operator Telecel plans to reduce its prices in March, its president Antonio Carrapatoso said on Wednesday.

Asked by Reuters if Telecel would cut prices to respond to a reduction announced last week by its main rival TMN, a unit of Portugal Telecom, Carrapatoso said: "Telecel will reduce its prices in March."
He gave no further details, but said the price cuts would be competitive with TMN's pricing.
TMN had said it would reduce prices on its products by up to 30 percent effective on March 1.
Carrapatoso was speaking before the announcement of a 199 percent increase in Telecel's 1996 net profit to 7.3 billion escudos from 2.4 billion in 1995.
